t: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
d: Nick and Sally need a strong piece of string to pull their train but it breaks and they don't have anything stronger. Later, they notice a bird flying back and forth into the tree branches.

t: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
d: The Cat takes Nick and Sally to the Magnetic Fields where they learn how magnets work. Later, Nick tries to learn how to ride his bike.

t: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
d: Sally wants to fly her kite but can't seem to work out the timing to get the wind right. Later, Cat takes Nick and Sally to Gravity Drop.

t: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
d: The Cat takes Nick and Sally on a journey but has to make an emergency landing on Lagoona-Maroon. Later, Nick and Sally go to a water park and learn that water always seeks the lowest level.

t: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
d: Sally is trying to make a vase for her mother but each one she tries falls over. Later, the Cat takes Nick and Sally to Arcade Island where they discover what will and won't be attracted to a magnet.

t: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
d: The Cat takes Sally and Nick to Machine-a-Ma-Zoo where they learn how a lever can solve their problem. Then, in Gongolia, they find out that bigger things make lower sounds.

t: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
d: Sally keeps getting found when they play Hide and Seek. Cat takes them to Tagaloo to meet a great seeker. Then, Cat takes them to the Hole-Lot-of Funhouse.

t: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
d: When Nick's magic trick causes his toy car to disappear under the porch, the Cat takes them to Arcade Island to win a Grasper-ma-clasper. Then, Cat takes them to Coldsnap Island.

t: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
d: Nick and Sally can't agree on the "right" way to sort their toys. The Cat takes them to Toborrowland. Then, the kids are making bubbles and want to save one for Sally's mum but they always pop!

t: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
d: When Nick's water glass suddenly falls over without anyone touching it, Cat comes to help them solve the mystery. Then, Cat takes them to the Jingly Jungle for a concert by the great Vibrato.

t: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
d: Nick and Sally's soccer game is obstructed by a large log that they can't lift out of the way. Then, Nick's new plane is flying well but is a little dull so the kids add buttons and glitter.

t: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
d: Cat shrinka-ma-doodles them so they're small enough to be in the train set. Then, Cat takes Sally and Nick to a place where they can get more sticks.

t: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
d: Sally is convinced that a tall thin glass of juice holds more than a short wide glass so Cat takes them to Point O'View. Then, Nick and Sally wonder if they can walk on a cloud.

t: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
d: Sally invents a secret treehouse handshake but Nick can't remember the sequence. The Cat takes them to Over-and-Overton. Then, The Cat says he needs their help to move some big pictures.
